name: McCracken County, KY
findings: McCracken County has 257 nonprofit organizations. 99 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 75 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, McCracken County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 28 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
